source_group_order: SHA256(split_label + vertical bar + human-readable article title)
scope: Numeric-answer controlled suite on unused article groups; not representative of all QA, not an official SQuAD evaluation, no upstream-pretraining exclusion guarantee.
same_question_panel: The 1200 test hosts may be reused across templates for paired comparisons; template rows never inflate independent source-question count.
eligibility: 50-220 context words;5-30 question words;3-55 answer characters;1-5 answer words;initial uppercase/digit;one consistent annotated answer;one exact source occurrence and exact answer offsets;explicit current-time words excluded.
numeric_eligibility: Nonnegative integer or fixed-point decimal with optional valid thousands commas;bounded numeric span;target differs by nonzero multiple of7, preserves decimal precision/comma use, and is absent by numeric value and substring.
calibration_selection: One question per unique paragraph;balanced round-robin article selection with deterministic per-article question/paragraph hash order.
test_selection: One numeric question per unique paragraph;balanced round-robin among eligible test articles.
